HqFnoxRef.description: Host-local fnox lookup; the value itself is never configuration.
HqFnoxRef.title: HqFnoxRef

description:
``plugins.beadlog-xtdb`` — the XTDB BeadLog store plugin (host-owned; off by default).

Enabling it makes ``bh backfill apply|export --store xtdb`` reach the operator-run node named
by ``dsn``; ``bh plugin beadlog-xtdb doctor`` checks the node and this host. Nothing here
starts a node, and no key holds a secret.

credential.description: Host-local fnox lookup (config_path, profile, key) of the node's XTDB_PASSWORD; the value is resolved by the secret broker when needed and never stored, logged or echoed. Unset = no password (doctor reports it).

data_dir.description: Absolute host path mounted as the node's /var/lib/xtdb, for the doctor's filesystem check (a tmpfs or ramfs directory is refused). Unset = not checked.
data_dir.title: Data Dir

dsn.description: libpq connection string (key=value or postgresql:// URI) of the loopback XTDB pgwire port. Never a password: one embedded here is refused; the password comes from `credential`.
dsn.title: Dsn

health_url.description: The node's loopback healthz URL, probed with GET (the stock image HEALTHCHECK sends HEAD, which XTDB answers 405).
health_url.title: Health Url

image.description: The digest-pinned XTDB image the operator runs (`<repo>@sha256:<64 hex>`; a tag such as `latest` is refused). Doctor warns when it is not the validated digest.
image.title: Image
